_comment: Single source of truth for all discipline rules. Edit here — scorer, guardrails and reports all read this file. Times are IST wall-clock minutes (e.g. 810 = 13:30).
_sizeCap_comment: FIXED 2026-07-28 (Anoop): was 6, silently 3x looser than the documented hard rule (CLAUDE.md rule #2: max 2 contracts/entry). The 150K eval breach on 2026-07-21 was exactly this — sized 5 lots, doubled to 10, against a stated 2-cap the app was never actually enforcing at this number.
_tradeLimit_comment: SUPERSEDED 2026-07-28 by tradesPerSession/tradesPerDay below — kept only so any code path still reading the old shape doesn't crash. Do not raise this back up as the active limit.
_qualifying_comment: 2026-07-28 (Anoop): only trades that closed with |P&L| >= $100 count toward the 5/session, 10/day cap. Anything that closed between -$100 and +$100 is a scratch/near-breakeven trade and doesn't count as one of the 5.

scalperRules._comment: Override rules when tradingMode === 'scalper'. Anything NOT listed here falls through to the standard rules above.
